background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with no rating move since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 4 Nov 2022. CET1 of 14.9% and LCR of 129% are both in the top quarter of US banks, but leverage of 4.9% is in the bottom quarter, the usual shape for a securities-heavy balance sheet and the figure to watch. Since 30 Jun 2025 leverage has fallen 0.6 points, while CET1 and LCR have been broadly flat. Flagged news in the last 90 days is minor, an emailed deal pipeline and broker notes on other companies, the newest on 9 Oct 2026.
